Pinned by test/test_tier1_residue.py::test_free_attack_pile_guard_keeps_a_draw_pile_attack_costed. WAS: NARROWED 2026-07-27. THE PHASE HALF IS CLOSED: the sim has the Late pass (hooks.py's `_PHASES`, resolved by `_each`) and this power uses it -- `modify_card_energy_cost_late`, powers.py:1549-1561 -- so it is guaranteed to run after Tangled's plain-pass `modify_card_energy_cost`, which is what FreeAttackPower.cs:14's TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate means. BeforeCardPlayed.issue: CLOSED 2026-07-29 (round 10, the Tier 1 residue). The power now listens on `before_card_played` -- the hook FreeAttackPower.cs:43 actually declares -- instead of `on_energy_spent`. `before_card_played` is dispatched once per CardPlay from inside `_resolve_card_play`'s play-count loop (Hook.BeforeCardPlayed, CardModel.cs:1929), where `on_energy_spent` fires ONCE per logical play outside it. The pile guard (FreeAttackPower.cs:48-59, `card.Pile?.Type is Hand or Play`) is ported too, via the new `PlayerCombatState.pile_type_of` -- the sim had no way to ask which pile holds a card, and PileType.Play is not a fifth list but the `_playing_card` mark on a card parked in the discard. On this hook the guard cannot currently be false (a card being played is always in Play limbo), which is recorded rather than argued: it is load-bearing on the cost hook, not here. EXECUTED: a Hidden-Gem'd Strike (base_replay_count 1, playCount 2) against 3 stacks leaves 1 where the old port left 2. Pinned by test/test_tier1_residue.py::test_free_attack_consumes_one_stack_per_replay_iteration. RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-04 (line numbers only) by reading combat.py's `_play_count_loop` (combat.py:1147-1209) and powers.py:1521-1567. WAS: NARROWED 2026-07-27, and the reason it stands has changed. `before_card_played` ITSELF now fires once per replay iteration (inside the playCount loop) -- hook_dispatch G4 is fixed at the dispatch. But this power is hosted on `on_energy_spent`, which fires ONCE per logical play, outside `_resolve_card_play` and therefore outside the loop (the auto-play site is likewise once). So a Throwing-Axe- or Duplication-doubled Attack still consumed TWO Free Attack stacks in the game (BeforeCardPlayed per iteration, CardModel.cs:1929) and ONE in the sim. The deliberate slot choice recorded here is now the SOLE cause of the count gap rather than a bystander to it, and the missing pile guard (FreeAttackPower.cs:48-59) is unchanged.
